meta.title: A spasso con Daisy · Chianti Home — Dog-friendly apartments in Chianti

welcome.title: An oasis of traditions, tales and ancient flavours
poem: Joyful bells herald a feast day, while flowers perfume the air;
ancient stone houses, like dots upon the horizon, people the land;
the stream runs calm through cool woods, cypresses and gentle hills.
An oasis stands ready to welcome weary travellers, woven of traditions and tales, of ancient flavours:
paragraphs: We look forward to welcoming you into warm, homely surroundings, built in keeping with Tuscan tradition, just twenty-five kilometres from both Florence and Siena.

You will discover intimate spaces – modest in size, yet with room enough for a wonderful holiday, be it short or long. Furnished in a classic yet welcoming style and equipped with every comfort, they will make your stay quite unlike any other.

highlights.title: Kitchenette
highlights.text: Fitted with modern appliances, for enjoying traditional Tuscan cooking and tasting the local produce.

highlights.title: Pools and whirlpool
highlights.text: When the summer sun floods our land with light, the pool and whirlpool restore body and mind.

highlights.title: Fireplace
highlights.text: The flickering fire keeps winter warm; should you prefer, there is gas central heating too.

highlights.title: Wellbeing at home
highlights.text: A hydromassage shower, steam bath and infrared sauna to help you find your balance again.

apartments.title: Two apartments, one spirit
apartments.intro: Intimate, light-filled rooms furnished in classic style, where paintings, sculpture, ceramics and photographs tell the story of Tuscany in displays that change with every season.

units.name: Il Bilocale
units.tagline: A one-bedroom apartment, with a fireplace in the sitting room and a separate double bedroom
units.text: The warmth of a fire in the sitting room, a double bedroom all your own and a kitchenette for discovering the flavours of Chianti. Ideal for couples and small families.
units.illustration_alt: Illustration of the sitting room in Il Bilocale, with exposed beams, a fireplace and the bedroom

units.name: Il Monolocale
units.tagline: An intimate open-plan studio, designed for two
units.text: A single, cosy room with a double bed and kitchenette – perfect for a romantic escape or a few days of remote working surrounded by greenery.
units.illustration_alt: Illustration of Il Monolocale, with a double bed, kitchenette and a window looking out over the hills

dogs.title: Here, small dogs are guests of honour
dogs.text: Daisy is waiting to take you out for a walk through her favourite places: the park just below the house, the woodland paths, the white gravel roads that wind between vines and olive trees. Every small dog is welcome, and will find a little gift waiting just for them.

items.text: A special welcome for your four-legged friend
Dog grooming at the apartment, by appointment
Walks in the Abbot’s Park (Parco dell’Abate) and the woods around the house
A walking and cycling path along the Pesa

dogs.note: We welcome small dogs: do write to us about anything your travelling companion may need.
dogs.illustration_alt: Illustration of Daisy trotting along a white gravel road between cypress trees

territory.title: Hills, vineyards and timeless villages
territory.intro: To leave the stresses of everyday life behind, you need only discover the enchanting places around us: hills clothed in vineyards that give rise to great wines, dotted with centuries-old olive trees whose oil is prized the world over. From the greenery rise fortified hamlets, little villages and castles, rich in culture and in traditions that reach back over a thousand years.

places.title: The park of the mastodons
places.text: Just below the house lies the park where, some 2.5 million years ago, the mastodons of Sambuca roamed – elephant-like giants whose presence is attested by a palate with two molars, now kept in a museum. It is one of the most important natural sites in Chianti, with heirloom plants and fruit trees and places to gather.

places.title: Along the River Pesa
places.text: A route of great scenic beauty, where nature and spirituality meet, in the footsteps of Saint John Gualbert.

places.title: Badia a Passignano
places.text: Saint John Gualbert, born near Tavarnelle in the late tenth century and founder of the Vallombrosan Order, lived and now rests in the Abbey of San Michele Arcangelo.

places.title: Villages and castles
places.text: Fortified villages and castles rising from the greenery, guardians of art, history and age-old traditions.

territory.quote: Immerse yourself in the beauty of the past, and carry it into your future.

services.title: The heart of Chianti Classico, up close
services.intro: In this corner of Chianti you will feel at home, with the privilege of activities and services reserved for the most discerning guests.

blocks.title: Art that changes with the seasons
blocks.text: In tribute to the artistic treasures of Florence, the rooms of A spasso con Daisy are home to paintings, sculpture, ceramics and photographs, in displays renewed with every season.

blocks.title: Among the olive trees
blocks.text: Sun-kissed hills 450 metres above sea level: a land made special by the fruit it bears. We will walk with you among the trees that teach the art of patience, up to the dense canopy where the olives hide, and you will discover how daily care turns into colour, flavour and fragrance.

blocks.title: In the vineyards and the cellar
blocks.text: If you wish, you can walk among the vines and see how the soil changes with the wine it yields. In a small cellar – a temple of ancient rituals and modern technology – past, present and future live in harmony.

blocks.title: Bread from ancient grains
blocks.text: Our chef will teach you to bake bread with our own organic flours, milled from ancient grains. At the end of the lesson you will savour the treats you have made, fresh from the oven, with a good local craft beer.

blocks.title: Days on horseback
blocks.text: Magnificent horses can make your days with us truly special, with rides, lessons and moments of genuine connection.

Crockery and kitchenware

location.title: In the heart of Chianti Classico
location.text: You will find us in Barberino Tavarnelle, in the quiet of Sambuca Val di Pesa: far from the bustle and the traffic, yet close to every convenience.

travel.text: By car: Florence–Siena motorway (raccordo), Tavarnelle exit
By air: Florence and Pisa airports
By train: Firenze Santa Maria Novella and Siena stations
